article.title: IAB Australia發布搜尋技能框架，把AI與整體能見度納入培訓
article.summary: IAB Australia發布Future Search Skills，提出搜尋行銷人員在自動化環境下需要建立的技能。
highlights: 框架涵蓋AI搜尋、整體搜尋能見度，以及搜尋專長配合另一領域的複合技能。
研究提供四階段學習框架、六類複合角色及初級人才技能清單。
article.why: 當出價、建案和報表更自動化，團隊可重新分配培訓時間，讓初級同事仍能學會理解及覆查系統的決定。
article.next_step: 以一個搜尋活動列出AI已接手的工序，再用技能清單安排對應的人工分析與覆查練習。
article.detail: 官方頁面說明，研究結合品牌、代理商、媒體、平台及零售媒體工作小組的經驗，以及專門招聘搜尋和成效人才的招聘顧問調查。它也討論當點擊已不足以解釋表現時，如何衡量整體搜尋。主管可按現有活動的實際分工，決定哪些技能需要透過個案練習保留。研究亦把初級人才如何累積實務經驗列為專題。
article.title_en: IAB Australia sets out AI and whole-of-search skills for training
article.summary_en: IAB Australia published Future Search Skills to guide search marketers as routine work becomes automated.
highlights_en: The framework covers AI-driven search, whole-of-search visibility and combining search depth with another specialty.
It includes a four-stage learning framework, six hybrid personas and a junior skills checklist.
article.why_en: As bidding, setup and reporting automate, teams can preserve junior staff's ability to understand and review system decisions.
article.next_step_en: Map automated tasks in one search campaign to the checklist and design corresponding analysis and review exercises.
article.detail_en: The official page combines working-group expertise from brands, agencies, publishers, platforms and retail media with a specialist recruiter survey. It also addresses measurement when clicks alone do not explain performance. Managers can use the actual division of campaign work to choose skills that still need case-based practice.
